title: 2x Sunflower Vanilla Ice Plug Plants – Florist Quality, Creamy Yellow Blooms!
description: Bring a touch of elegance to your garden with these 2 healthy plug plants of the stunning Sunflower Vanilla Ice variety! Features: Florist quality blooms : Large clusters of light yellow and cream flowers with deep chocolate centres. Height : Grows 5-6 feet tall – a dramatic addition to any border! Perfect for cut flowers : One of the best sunflowers for bouquets and arrangements. Easy to grow : Suitable for borders, cottage gardens, and pollinator-friendly spaces. Growing Instructions: Plant out after all danger of frost has passed. May require staking in exposed positions. Protect young plants from slugs and snails. Steadily harden off before planting outside.
